plan.title: Convert Closed RFQ to Auction Without Reuse

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the stage Settings menu containing Convert to Auction.

args.goal: In the Convert to Auction pop-up, select the option to reuse nothing, continue, fill the auction configuration, and stop on the converted auction create screen showing only the RFQ products and no reused participants

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated assertion for the conversion pop-up's reuse options, so perform and verify the buyer-side selection directly on screen.
Verify that the converted auction retains the RFQ product line item.
Set and commit the auction schedule.
Add participants explicitly, verifying they were not reused by the conversion.
